Subject: New isolated enclave + cluster capacity at renewal

Vanessa —

Quick context: our PCI project (card-processor) is coming up for renewal in mid-August and the compliance team is insisting on a logically and network-isolated enclave for all cardholder data processing. We currently run on Redwood Shared-Private topology (single VPC, multi-tenant clusters). At renewal we'd like to: 

- Add a dedicated isolated VPC/enclave (dedicated control plane + nodes) for PCI workloads, with strict egress controls.
- Provision 3 additional inference clusters (same spec as production: 8xA100-equivalent) to support projected Q4 load (peak 2x current).
- Align contract term to our fiscal year (extend 6 -> 18 months total from renewal date) so we don't have mid-term adjustments during our product ramp.

Can you share feasibility, high-level lead times, and a ballpark delta in monthly committed cost if we commit to an 18-month term and the additional clusters? Attached: current-deployment-topology.pdf (small diagram).

Also looping infra-ops (cc) so they can flag any network requirements early.

Thanks —
Alex

Alex / Vanessa —

Quick technical note from intake review (based on the topology PDF + internal checklist):

- Isolation model: We can provision a customer-dedicated control plane + separate VPC with one-way egress through an approved NAT/gateway. If MediaTab requires no internet egress, we'll need an approved outbound proxy and pinned IPs for telemetry.
- Network: Expect 3 dedicated subnets per AZ for cluster nodes + a management subnet. We'll need a CIDR block at least /20 to avoid overlap with your existing VPCs.
- Certs / KMS: We support customer-managed keys (KMS) for the Private package; bring-your-own-HSM is an option but adds 4+ weeks procurement.
- Sizing: To meet 2x peak headroom we recommend provisioning 3 clusters sized as follows: each cluster = 8xA100-class GPUs (or equivalent). If latency SLOs are aggressive (<= 30ms p50), consider keeping one cluster at higher-memory instance type for longest-context models.
- Lead time: From signed amendment to env provision ~ 5-7 weeks (standard), or 8-10 weeks if HSM procurement is needed.

I'll attach our short network_req_checklist.txt and a sample security boundary diagram. For the Tue sync we should confirm: required CIDR, compliance checklist items that must be on the isolated host (logging/retention/audit level), and whether MediaTab wants automated KV-cache separation or shared prefix caching.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Alex / team —

Thanks — following up on commercials after the technical intake. High-level pricing delta (ballpark):

- Base: current committed spend = $48,000 / month (existing Private baseline).
- Additional 3 clusters (8xA100-class each) => incremental committed capacity: $32,500 / month.
- Isolated Enclave (dedicated control plane + network isolation) => one-time provisioning fee $18,000, plus $4,000 / month overhead for dedicated control plane + monitoring.

If MediaTab commits to an 18-month term on the new footprint (adds 12 months from renewal), we can offer a 12% committed discount on incremental cluster capacity and waive 50% of the one-time provisioning fee. Example blended incremental monthly delta with discount: ~$30,600 / month.

Attached: quote_renewal_2027.xlsx (line-item breakout) and a draft term_amendment_draft.docx for legal redline (shows the 18-month alignment and SLA addendum).
